documents.title: Performance Specification: Cartridge, 7.62mm: Armor Piercing - M993
documents.velocity_reference: Measured at 78 ft (24 m) from the muzzle. The average velocity shall be within plus or minus 10 m/s (33 ft/s) of the velocity determined during design verification. The specification does not state an absolute velocity.
documents.pressure_reference: Average chamber pressure at ambient temperature shall be not greater than 380 MPa (55,115 psi). Neither an individual cartridge nor the average plus three standard deviations shall exceed 400 MPa (58,016 psi). Average chamber pressure at hot or cold temperature shall be not greater than 420 MPa (60,917 psi). Average port pressure at ambient temperature shall be 60 to 85 MPa (8,702 to 12,328 psi).
documents.notes: The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. The cartridge interfaces with the M240 series machine gun and the M24 rifle. The document is distribution statement A.

documents.title: Military Specification: Cartridge, Caliber .50, Ball, M33
documents.velocity_reference: 78 ft from the muzzle, conditioned at 70 F. The average velocity shall be 2910 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s. The standard deviation shall not exceed 36 ft/s. Test method 4.5.6 and 4.5.10.
documents.pressure_reference: The average chamber pressure shall not exceed 55,000 psi (379.2 MPa), conditioned at 70 F. Test method 4.5.7 and 4.5.10.
documents.notes: The source PDF is a scan with no text layer. Values were extracted with tesseract and checked against the page images. Amendment 4 (26 July 2000) adds an EPVAT alternative of 2905 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s at 78 ft and an EPVAT chamber pressure limit of 65,000 psi. The base values above do not change. The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. It covers quality assurance and delivery for the M33 ball cartridge.

documents.title: Military Specification: Cartridges, Caliber .50: Armor-Piercing-Incendiary, M8; and Armor-Piercing-Incendiary-Tracer, M20
documents.velocity_reference: 78 ft from the muzzle, conditioned at 68 to 72 F. The average velocity shall be 2910 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s. The standard deviation shall not exceed 36 ft/s.
documents.pressure_reference: The average chamber pressure shall not exceed 55,000 psi (379.2 MPa), conditioned at 68 to 72 F.
documents.notes: One document covers the M8 API and the M20 API-T projectiles. The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. Amendment 1 (26 July 2000) adds an EPVAT alternative of 2905 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s at 78 ft and EPVAT chamber pressure limits of 65,000 psi for the M8 API and 60,500 psi for the M20 API-T. The base values above do not change.

documents.title: Military Specification: Cartridge, Caliber .50, Tracer, M17
documents.velocity_reference: 78 ft from the muzzle, conditioned at 70 F plus or minus 2 F for a minimum of two hours. Velocity test barrel method: 2910 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s. EPVAT method: 2905 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s. The standard deviation shall not exceed 36 ft/s.
documents.pressure_reference: Copper crush-cylinder method: the average chamber pressure shall not exceed 55,000 psi (379.2 MPa). EPVAT method: the average chamber pressure shall not exceed 65,000 psi (448.2 MPa). The cartridges are conditioned at 70 F plus or minus 2 F for a minimum of two hours.
documents.notes: The base specification is MIL-C-1318B dated 3 April 1985. This record is Amendment 5, dated 26 July 2000, which restates paragraphs 3.8 and 3.9 in full. The base document is not available on everyspec.com. The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. MIL-C-1318B was inactivated for new design on 29 August 1997.

documents.title: Military Specification: Cartridge, 7.62mm, NATO, Match, M118
documents.velocity_reference: 78 ft from the muzzle, conditioned at 70 F plus or minus 2 F. The average velocity shall be 2550 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s. The standard deviation shall not exceed 28 ft/s.
documents.pressure_reference: The average chamber pressure shall not exceed 50,000 psi (344.7 MPa). Neither an individual cartridge nor the average plus three standard deviations shall exceed 55,000 psi (379.2 MPa). Conditioned at 70 F plus or minus 2 F.
documents.notes: Amendment 6 (11 March 1991) renames the cartridge from MATCH to SPECIAL BALL. It does not change the velocity or the chamber pressure. Accuracy requirement: the average of the mean radii at 600 yards shall not exceed 3.5 inches. Port pressure: 12,500 psi plus or minus 2,000 psi. The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. The propellant charge is checked against a 25 grain minimum.
